title: NIM Codex - schematic command reference
description: Searchable relational datastore of shell commands with metadata, tagging/grouping automation, command + subshell interfaces, and topical markdown export. Program spec: ../CLAUDE.md (ENVIRONMENT MODULES CODEX). Requires Easley cluster discovery (remote - phase D).

objectives.text: Review bash code style and systemic/functional patterns in /usr/local/nim/lib/sh (NIM Metashell)
objectives.acceptance: written pattern digest committed to the project as a spec

objectives.text: Select core ontology for the command/catalog data model (shell/os/command/syntax/catalog/index standards review)
Design codex schema: command entity + metadata (title, descriptions, related/alternative commands, tags, groups)
Build nim.codex command mode: pipe-store, set (session tag/group defaults), add subcommands
Build nim.codex subshell mode with contextual usage and menu-driven control
Inference/regex auto-tagging and grouping on add operations
Topical markdown export of command groups/subsets with metadata
Easley cluster discovery: lmod subsystem, MODULEPATH modulefiles, toolchains, /tools mappings (BLOCKED: remote access = phase D)

directives: Command-mode and subshell interfaces share one datastore and one schema - no divergence
